responsibility: Provides the PA64 HP-UX operating-system and runtime configuration, covering both GNU-ld and HP-ld toolchains. It customizes 64-bit HP-UX link and library specs, tool and startfile search paths, ELF-versus-HP-assembler assembly conventions, external symbol typing, internal label syntax, startup/endfile sequences for different HP-UX UNIX levels, init/fini handling, weak-symbol and thread-library policies, and other driver/runtime details needed to build PA64 HP-UX executables and shared libraries.
same_name_distinction: 64-bit HP-UX configuration header for PA: unlike pa64-hpux.opt, it contains the substantive driver, linker, assembler, startup/endfile, and runtime macro customization for the PA64 HP-UX target, including GNU-ld versus HP-ld dependent specs.
